verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL documents native ANSI SQL support with Delta Lake extensions. That implies standard analytical constructs such as window functions and CTEs, but none is named. A community report mentions a native Snowflake-style VARIANT type for semi-structured data, though with usability pain; that is friction, not a failure, so it does not create a dispute. missing for 10: explicit documentation of window functions, CTEs, JSON functions, array types and rich date/time types, plus independent hands-on corroboration of the analytical SQL surface.
